payload.criterion: Real entry point bin/aff check and close-batch --help succeed; se-workflow bin and package gone
payload.verify_command: test -x bin/aff && ! test -e bin/se-workflow && bin/aff check --help >/dev/null && bin/aff close-batch --help >/dev/null && python3 -c "import importlib.util as u; assert u.find_spec('affidavit'); assert u.find_spec('se_workflow') is None"
